purpose: Frozen relevant legacy CI recipe fields; not a current workflow or execution plan.
run-name: ${{ inputs.promotion_run != '' && format('CI promotion {0} at {1}', inputs.promotion_run, inputs.promotion_sha) || '' }}

steps.name: Verify the dispatched promotion snapshot before checkout
Require all main-push coverage at the dispatched release snapshot
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os

results = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"])
phase = os.environ["PROMOTION_PHASE"]
if phase not in ("candidate", "release"):
    raise SystemExit("Unknown promotion qualification phase.")
if phase == "release":
    if results.get("full", {}).get("result") != "skipped":
        raise SystemExit("Legacy release verification unexpectedly changed full-suite coverage.")
    results.pop("full")
bad = {name: info["result"] for name, info in results.items()
       if info["result"] != "success"}
if bad:
    raise SystemExit(f"Required promotion snapshot coverage did not succeed: {bad}")
print("Every required main-push job succeeded at this release snapshot.")
PY
